name: shurly/mcp/calls-per-tool
queryString:
filter event = "mcp.tool_call"
| stats count(*) as calls by tool
| sort calls desc

name: shurly/mcp/errors-per-tool
queryString:
filter event = "mcp.tool_call" and outcome = "error"
| stats count(*) as errors by tool, error_type, http_status
| sort errors desc

name: shurly/mcp/latency-per-tool
queryString:
filter event = "mcp.tool_call"
| stats count(*) as calls, pct(duration_ms, 50) as p50_ms, pct(duration_ms, 95) as p95_ms by tool
| sort p95_ms desc

name: shurly/mcp/active-users-per-day
queryString:
filter event = "mcp.tool_call"
| stats count_distinct(user_id) as users, count(*) as calls by bin(1d)

name: shurly/requests/one-request
queryString:
filter request_id = "<id>"
| fields @timestamp, event, method, path, status, tool, outcome, duration_ms
| sort @timestamp asc

name: shurly/web-app/calls-per-area
queryString:
filter event = "http.request" and status < 400 and path like /^\/api\/v1\//
| parse path /^\/api\/v1\/(?<area>[a-z-]+)/
| stats count(*) as calls by method, area
| sort calls desc

name: shurly/web-app/links-and-campaigns-made-by-week
queryString:
filter event = "http.request" and method = "POST" and status = 201 and (path = "/api/v1/urls" or path = "/api/v1/campaigns")
| stats count(*) as made by path, bin(7d)

name: shurly/web-app/analytics-tabs-and-csvs
queryString:
filter event = "http.request" and status < 400 and path like /^\/api\/v1\/analytics\/(urls|campaigns)\//
| parse path /\/(?<what>totals|timeseries|breakdown|visits|visits\.csv|recipients|recipients\.csv)$/
| stats count(*) as calls by what
| sort calls desc

name: shurly/errors/client-errors
queryString:
filter event = "client.error"
| stats count(*) as reports, count_distinct(user_id) as people by kind, message, page
| sort reports desc

name: shurly/errors/5xx-by-path
queryString:
filter event = "http.request" and status >= 500
| stats count(*) as errors by path, status
| sort errors desc

name: shurly/requests/client-ip-source-per-host
queryString:
filter event = "http.request" and path != "/api/v1/health"
| stats count(*) as requests by host, client_ip_source
| sort requests desc

name: shurly/geo/database-events
queryString:
filter event like /^geo\.database/
| fields @timestamp, event, path, database_type, built, age_days, primary_error
| sort @timestamp desc

name: shurly/auth/logins-by-method
queryString: filter event = "auth.login" | stats count() by method
